lever: title_ident: one sentence at the end of step 1 (Locate) of prompts/system.md. If the title is a short phrase in plain English, also search that phrase joined the way code names things (two terms joined by an underscore) before opening a file named after just one term of it.
why: 14 of 14 patched runs (4 box, 10 Kaggle L4) edited the module named after the title's first term; p4_b1024 and p4_v0t2 opened it as their first call without searching. At base the joined phrase names 9 lines in 2 files, 7 in the table module, including the measurement function the gold changes (the single term: 191 lines in 32 files). A fix that copies the renderer's pad_edge rule into that function passes 22 of 22 (both F2P). Measured offline.
baseline: p4, p4_v7, p4_v7c, p4_v7d, p4_b1024, p4_v0t2 all failed (0 of 6 box runs); 0 of 12 Kaggle L4 74-row runs
applies_outside_the_42: rich_3506 ('fix split cells' joins to the gold function's name; its body also names it, so redundant there). In the 42 also fastapi_14258 and rich_4079. Of the 74 public tasks, only rich_3935 needs it, so expect a small effect.
expected: maybe: the lever addresses the location failure; the agent must still see that the measurement skips the renderer's pad_edge rule (a default Table does not show the bug, a grid does).
risk: Text-call leaks (coordinator, 2026-10-14, corrected): on the v13 box screen fastapi_14487's first reply put its tool call in the message text and never recovered (0 tool calls). Such leaks are not new (10 in the six earlier box runs, 5 on b1024, all recovered after the harness nudge); one unrecovered case does not show that v13's prompt caused it. This bundle inherits v13's step 3 unchanged; as a precaution the added sentence has no fenced block, backtick, brace, underscore or tool-call-shaped text (pinned by tests/test_v13_title_ident.py). A sample that ends with 0 tool calls should be read as that leak, not as this lever. Lever-specific: on rich_4076 the thinking-off locators searched a joined title that matched nothing and resent it about 60 times; a sample looping on an empty joined search counts against this lever.
